description: Renders one row of a TmNotionTableBlock as a <tr> of editable cells. Applies the header-row/header-column styling, the per-column horizontal alignment, cell background colours, merge spans, range-selection highlight, drag handles for row reordering, and Tab/Shift+Tab navigation across cells.

parameters.name: Row
parameters.description: The TableRow block whose Content is an ITableRowBlockContent (Cells or RichCells).

parameters.name: RowIndex
parameters.description: Zero-based index of this row inside the table; used for selection and cell focus.

parameters.name: ColumnCount
parameters.description: Number of columns to render. Rows with fewer cells are padded with empty cells.

parameters.name: ColumnAlignments
parameters.description: Per-column horizontal alignment imported from a GFM table separator row. Columns beyond the list keep the renderer default (None).

parameters.name: ColumnWidths
parameters.description: Optional preferred width for each canonical table column in CSS pixels.

parameters.name: IsHeaderRow
parameters.description: Renders the row with header styling (shaded background, semibold text).

parameters.name: HasHeaderColumn
parameters.description: Renders the first cell of the row with header styling.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Removes the drag handle and renders the cells non-editable.

parameters.name: IsDragging
parameters.description: Whether this row is the one currently being dragged.

parameters.name: IsDragOver
parameters.description: Whether a dragged row is currently hovering over this row.

parameters.name: CanDelete
parameters.description: Shows the delete-row affordance. The last remaining row cannot be deleted.

parameters.name: IsCellSelected
parameters.description: Predicate (row, column) telling the row whether a given cell is inside the current selection range.

parameters.name: OnCellsChanged
parameters.description: Fired on cell blur when any cell content changed. Arg = the full new cell list of this row.

parameters.name: OnDeleteRequested
parameters.description: Fired when the user activates the delete-row affordance.

parameters.name: OnFocused
parameters.description: Fired when a cell in this row receives focus.

parameters.name: OnTabFromLastCell
parameters.description: Fired when Tab is pressed in the last cell — the table moves focus to the first cell of the next row.

parameters.name: OnShiftTabFromFirstCell
parameters.description: Fired when Shift+Tab is pressed in the first cell — the table moves focus to the last cell of the previous row.

parameters.name: OnDragStart
parameters.description: Fired when the user starts dragging this row by its handle.

parameters.name: OnDragOver
parameters.description: Fired while a dragged row hovers over this row.

parameters.name: OnDrop
parameters.description: Fired when a dragged row is dropped onto this row.

parameters.name: OnDragEnd
parameters.description: Fired when the drag gesture ends, regardless of whether a drop happened.

parameters.name: OnCellMouseDown
parameters.description: Fired on mouse-down in a cell; starts a range selection.

parameters.name: OnCellMouseEnter
parameters.description: Fired when the pointer enters a cell while a range selection is being dragged.

parameters.name: OnCellMouseUp
parameters.description: Fired on mouse-up in a cell; completes a range selection.
